title: Save and Quit
summary: Rest in a bed aboard the train to save and quit, then come back to your run where you left it.
highlights: Resting in a train bed to save and quit now offers the feedback questions, a way to support the line, and a closing look at the life still underway
Before you go, the bed shows everything you are carrying and asks if you are willing to risk it
The death screen's train rides in the top bar, and each page now sits centred under its title
description:
Train beds now let you save and quit.

Rest in a bed aboard the train and you can step away from the line, then come back to your run where you left it. Before you go, the train shows everything you are carrying, asks a few quick questions, and ends on a look at the life still underway: your past lives traced across the stars, and this one still drawing its path.

This is still in development, so only use it if you are willing to lose what you carry. Keep anything precious in an Ender Chest for your next life.
